"# Walkthrough - Roles Hub Daily Lineup & Floor Plan Planner Redesign

Refactored the Roles Hub to feature a **Daily Lineup & Floor Plan Planner** as the primary view, replacing the massive, overwhelming weekly grid of 105 dropdowns. This makes managing daily operational shifts, employee absences, and station coverage highly visual and stress-free.

Also implemented backend fallback resolution and quick auto-fill actions.

---

## Changes Made

### 📋 Database & Backend Fallback
- **Schedule Publisher Route** ([app/api/notifications/publish-schedule/route.ts](file:///c:/Users/pedro/Desktop/teg-modernizado/app/api/notifications/publish-schedule/route.ts)):
  - Implemented dynamic fallback resolution of activities from Toast job titles if no manual station assignment is configured for the day.
  - Added a robust store name checks fallback for Drive-Thru (`hasDT`) stores (`NORWALK`, `RIALTO`, `SANTA ANA`, etc.) to resolve correct activities even when `station_assignments` is empty.
  - Resolved fallback roles are displayed with a green/teal **"Rol"** badge in emails.

### 🌐 Frontend (Daily Lineup & Floor Plan Board)
- **Primary Daily Lineup Interface** ([app/roles/page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/pedro/Desktop/teg-modernizado/app/roles/page.tsx)):
  - Added `viewMode` toggle state supporting both **Alineación Diaria (Daily Lineup)** (default) and **Grilla Semanal (Weekly Matrix)** views.
  - **Left Panel (Roster Today)**: Lists scheduled employees for the day/shift. Categorized as "Available", "Assigned", and "Absent". Enables 1-click station assignments.
  - **Right Panel (Station Cards)**: Renders each station as a beautiful visual card showing the assigned employee, their daily resolved activities checklist, or a "Vacante" selector showing uncovered activities.
